title: Guest Favorite | Spacious 3BR. Minutes to Downtown
description:
Welcome to your perfect home away from home! This Honkytonk Hideaway is a 3-bedroom, 1-bathroom. It is  located just 7 miles from Downtown, offering a delightful blend of comfort and convenience. Nestled in a quiet neighborhood, you’ll love the inviting front porch, a fully equipped kitchen ready for your culinary adventures, and Roku TVs in every bedroom for your entertainment. Enjoy nearby dining at Big Bad Breakfast, a nice steak from Longhorn , or shop at Costco, Target, and Trader Joe’s.

The space
Experience comfort and privacy in this spacious This home features a full kitchen, cozy dining room, 1 bathroom, and 3 bedrooms, each with a queen bed. Enjoy exclusive access to the entire main level, with ample parking in the half-circle driveway. The owners reside separately in a private basement apartment, ensuring your space is entirely your own. We respect your privacy and guarantee no shared areas or interruptions. Your peaceful getaway awaits!

Guest access
You have access to the entire main house. You do not have access to the fenced-in back yard or the basement. We live downstairs in the mother in law apartment. We never enter the main house while it’s rented. You have your own entrance, and so do we.

Other things to note
Only the number of guests specified in your reservation is permitted on the property. Please note that we have two dogs, Lizzy and Thor, who live with us downstairs. They do bark and stay in the fenced-in backyard during the day but come inside at night.
